illegal_stage1.elisa:16: warning: local `tmp` stays visible after its last use [-Wnever-leak]
  declared on line 16, last used on line 18; still visible across 1 later statement (line 19, starting with `sink(doubled)`)
  kind: chain with a loop jump (its last use binds another local, and a `break`/`continue` for an enclosing loop lies in between)
  fix: nest it in a block expression that ends with its last use:
              doubled: i64 =
                  tmp: i64 = x * 2
                  continue if tmp < 0
                  tmp + 1
              sink(doubled)
  (the `break`/`continue` inside the block still leaves the enclosing loop: a block expression may end early that way, and the binding is then never made)
illegal_stage1.elisa:23: warning: local `sums` is filled by a push loop and stays mutable after it [-Wnever-leak]
  `sums`: declared `mutable` and empty on line 23; filled only by the loop on lines 24-27, one `sums.push` per element that passes its filter; read only after it (first read: line 28)
  kind: push loop (a `mutable` darray that starts empty, that only a loop fills with `push`, and that only code after the loop reads)
  why: once the loop ends `sums` is complete, yet it stays `mutable` and in scope, so any later line could still change it; a comprehension builds the same elements in the same order as one immutable binding, in one expression (over a range or a darray with no filter it also allocates the array once, instead of growing it push by push)
  fix: replace lines 23-27 with:
          sums: darray[i64] = [x * 10 + y for x in xs if x > 1 for y in ys]
